summary: Source-reviewed rework resolved the owner-layer blocker by extracting local PDF/XML activity rows, preserving DBAASP/primary-source conflicts, and replacing the framework-test adjudication shell with paper-specific worker-6 review. Acceptance is with cautions, not clean acceptance.

paper_pdf.coverage: Table 1, Figure 5, rendered Figure 8, rendered Figure 9, rendered Figure 10, figure captions, and results text

Direct mechanism retained only for SEM membrane/cell-envelope damage; computational and antibiofilm claims are not promoted to direct mechanism.
rwk-complete-test-0001 resolved by this owner-layer re-review; final rework_targets is empty.

caution_findings.note: Most linked activity rows are source-supported by local figures/text but carry database abstractions, target-label differences, or ppm vs ug/mL wording; conflicts are preserved instead of forced to source_verified.
Primary Figure 8/9 captions use K. pneumoniae ATCC 70063, while DBAASP linked rows use ATCC 700603.
Primary method says bovine red blood cells; database target says human erythrocytes. Final activity row follows the primary-source bovine RBC method and database audit preserves the conflict.

Local supplementary assets are indexed Nature HTML landing copies linking to a remote DOCX; no local DOCX/XLSX/PDF supplementary table file exists. Activity/toxicity/database blockers were resolved from article XML/PDF figures and packet database rows without external fetching.
Figure 10b bars do not print exact viability percentages; final row records the primary qualitative non-toxic/control-level conclusion and does not invent per-bar values.

layer_1_database_record_identity.rationale: DBAASP peptide identity and DOI linkage are source-reviewed against primary Figure 6/MALDI text. Exact assay values are matched to local figures where printed; target/unit/interpolated IC50 conflicts remain visible as source_conflict rows instead of being normalized away.
preserved_conflicts: K. pneumoniae ATCC 70063 vs database ATCC 700603
bovine RBC primary method vs database human erythrocytes
DBAASP IC50 interpolation values not primary text-table values

layer_2_activity_toxicity_evidence.rationale: Activity/toxicity rows now have concrete endpoints, raw values, raw units, targets, assay context, and locators. Figure-derived exact values were read from local rendered PDF figures; unlabeled Fig. 10b cell-viability bar values were not invented.

layer_3_mechanism_ontology.rationale: SEM morphology supports direct membrane/cell-envelope damage only in the tested P. aeruginosa setting; computational alpha-helix context and antibiofilm activity are kept as non-direct/supporting evidence.

supplementary_materials.rationale: No local DOCX/XLSX/PDF supplement was present beyond HTML landing copies. Because the owner-layer blocker was resolved from local XML/PDF/database evidence, this remains a documented caution rather than an open rework target.

final_adjudication.rationale: No blocking/major issue or open rework target remains after this bounded re-review; preserved conflicts are explicit cautions.
